measurement_contract.embedding: selector inference plus variable/style source transformation; CUDA synchronized before and after
measurement_contract.extraction: encoder plus bit decoder and threshold; CUDA synchronized before and after
measurement_contract.embedding_normalization: elapsed_seconds * 1,000,000 / Qwen reference tokens in input source
measurement_contract.extraction_normalization: elapsed_seconds * 1,000,000 / Qwen reference tokens in watermarked source
measurement_contract.aggregation: sum elapsed seconds / sum corresponding reference tokens
